title: Warhammer Survivors reveals its roadmap, with new characters, weapons and cross-save on the way
summary: One of my colleagues gave Warhammer Survivors a go this week and lasted about a minute before a stampede of rats ran them over. The weekend has since been set aside for revenge. Good timing, because Auroch Digital has just revealed a roadmap for the Survivors-like, which is out now on iOS and Android, and there’s a lot more on the way to die to. Most of the roadmap includes free updates over the next few months, adding new characters and weapons to both the Warhammer 40,000 and Age of Sigmar halves, along with QoL fixes. Smaller patches will fill the gaps between the bigger drops, with some of them landing before the end of the year.  ... [MORE]

title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby to bring its hit concert series to the UK with new event in London
summary: With Umamusume: Pretty Derby's planned concert in Los Angeles sadly cut short earlier this year due to visa issues for performers, many of you may have resigned yourselves to one less date on the highly anticipated tour. But, for the first time ever, Umamusume: Pretty Derby's live concert is coming to Europe from January 19th to the 20th! The 7th Event World Tour: The Stage concert, taking place at the Eventim Apollo, will open ticket sales on November 17th, and features the voice talents of the Umamusume cast, performing in-character with hit songs from the popular multiplatform mobile game. Names such as Chisa Kimura (Daiwa Scarlet), Sumire Uesaka (Agnes Tachyon) and Ayaka Ohashi (Vodka). ... [MORE]

summary: Aside from the obvious wealth of puns it allows, Ball x Pit has proven to be a big hit with fans of fast-paced roguelike action games. And now, the biggest expansion yet to Ball x Pit is set to land today, with the arrival of Risen Ballbylon and brand-new challenges for you to take on! As you might expect from the name, Risen Ballbylon, rather than seeing you descend into the Pit and the ruins of the once-great city, now has you rising above the clouds and into the floating metropolis above. Four new battlefields and forty new varieties of enemies pose a challenge even to the most devoted of ball masters. ... [MORE]

title: Poppy Playtime Chapter Five takes you into the depths of cute terror as it launches today
summary: Like it or loathe it, for many younger horror fans, Poppy Playtime trumps the likes of Resident Evil, Alien Isolation and even Five Nights at Freddy's in their estimation. Case in point: the seismic reaction to Poppy Playtime Chapter Five, which sold 110,000 copies in only three hours on PC, and which has now finally landed on iOS and Android! If you're not familiar, Poppy Playtime sees you delving into the ruined toy factory of Playtime Co., and unsurprisingly the enormous, spooky abandoned industrial relic turns out to be hosting a lot more than just asbestos and still water, with the vicious Huggy Wuggy (yes, really) dogging your steps as you delve further, and further, into the depths of the factory. ... [MORE]

title: Asphalt Legends sees iconic car manufacturer Ferrari get its own dedicated season
summary: Asphalt Legends Unite has covered some of the most famous automobile brands of all time. But one of their most well-known partnerships has been with none other than Ferrari. Now, the iconic Italian manufacturer is receiving its own dedicated season in Asphalt Legends! Ferrari Season, which runs until December 9th, introduces three new iconic cars to the track in Asphalt Legends. Currently, the Ferrari F800 has the spotlight, while the Ferrari 849 Testarossa arrives until November 25th, and the Ferrari 296 GT3 Evo until December 2nd. All of these cars are faithfully recreated from their real-world counterparts down to the smallest detail. ... [MORE]

title: PUBG Mobile Flash puts the battleground in the palm of your hand at less than 1 GB
summary: One of the biggest pain points for gaming nowadays is download size. And on mobile, especially if you're playing via data roaming, that's doubly true. Fortunately, if you're in need of a quick game, PUBG Mobile Flash puts the battleground in the palm of your hand lickety-split! As you might expect from the name (previously called PUBG Mobile Light), this is a stripped-down version of the original PUBG Mobile. Featuring the main map of Erangel and classic Battle Royale mode, both preinstalled. In total, this download size comes down to a minuscule 1 GB on Android and 2 GB on iOS! ... [MORE]

title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby teams up with the F1 Japanese Grand Prix 2027
summary: With its mixture of over-the-top musical numbers, adorable horse girl antics and genuinely thrilling race-day action, Umamusume: Pretty Derby has shot to fame all over the world. But nowhere else is it more popular than in its native Japan, especially as Umamusume: Pretty Derby is partnering with the 2027 F1 Japan Grand Prix. The partnership saw developer and publisher Cygames become a Founding Partner for the 2027 iteration of the competition, as well as getting naming rights to Suzuka Circuit's 130R corner. Naturally, this part of the track, which is well-known for its sharp turn, will be known as Umamusume 130R. ... [MORE]

title: Inside is a moody, critically acclaimed little indie platformer, coming to Android
summary: With all the big, flashy games releasing on mobile lately, you may have missed a humble but critically acclaimed game set to launch on Android. Yes, Playdead's seminal indie platformer Inside is coming to Android, with pre-registration now open so you can find out exactly what all the fuss has been about. In Inside, you play as a young boy in a world of technological horror, evading various hazards in your quest to find out what exactly is going on. Like Playdead's most famous game, Limbo, it's a moody, monochrome platformer that has you exploring a winding world of surreal and frightening imagery. ... [MORE]

title: Transformers: Eternal War lets you build a team of your favourite Decepticons and Autobots, out now

And if you're in that kind of mood, then you're in luck! Because Transformers: Eternal War has just landed on iOS and Android. With Unicron's Chaos Legion threatening both, using clones of Optimus Prime and Megatron, it seems that a common enemy is what's needed to bond the inhabitants of Cybertron once more. ... [MORE]

title: TrainStation 3: Journey of Steel tests your train tycoon tactics with a serious supply setback
summary: In any tycoon sim, there's something inherently satisfying about watching everything fall into place after all your hard work. But keeping everything running smoothly is a challenge in itself, as one bottleneck can have a knock-on effect across your entire operation – and that's exactly what you'll be tackling in TrainStation 3: Journey of Steel's latest Lumber Jam event! As you might expect, Pixel Federation's limited-time challenge will have you trying to untangle a tangled mess across the railroad tycoon's supply chain, identifying the weakest link and pushing you to test your logistical prowess. To make sure you control the reins on the railway, you'll need to hone your resource management skills too - thankfully, you've got plenty of factory upgrades to aim for to keep your Scandinavian supply run on track. ... [MORE]

title: G-Star Korea 2026 and G-Con set to showcase the best of Korea's games industry
summary: While we don't usually cover conferences in great detail, there are a few exceptions. The likes of Gamescom, of course, flash up on our radar, and occasionally we get to hit up other exciting shows. But one we've had our eye on recently is the G-Star 2026 event in South Korea. Hosted every year, G-Star offers a glimpse into the games industry of one of the biggest spots for mobile on the planet. And even if that's not your cup of tea, there's exciting behind-the-scenes discussions at G-Con that'll fascinate even the most sceptical gamer. Talks such as Shift Up's Kim Hyung-tae and Resident Evil creator Shinji Mikami in conversation, or an entire session devoted to Final Fantasy VII's influence on JRPGs make this a mecca for gaming fans. ... [MORE]

title: UnGodly brings brutal hack 'n slash action to mobile in the fine Frazetta tradition, out now
summary: Time to put aside flashy, colourful martial arts moves and get right to the hacking and slashing, as UnGodly, the brutal new fantasy RPG from Mark Otero (one of the key people behind Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes), lands today on iOS and Android. Set in the world of Dunmiir, a world ravaged by The Devouring, you play as gifted warriors called Primals who offer the only hope to defy fate and save the world. To do so, you'll need to hack 'n slash your way through foes big and small, wielding crude but effective weaponry, the power of magic and more. Think Diablo, but with a touch of Genshin and a sprinkle of Frazetta's famous paintings to wrap the world together. ... [MORE]

title: Gobs & Gears turns factory building into a goblin-powered demolition puzzle
summary: The best advice Gobs & Gears gives you is to build it wrong. It may sound counterintuitive, but you lay out a route, rip it up the moment it’s done its job, and blow up the odd building along the way, all to finish a bomb for a goblin king who wants it immediately. It’s a logistics puzzler that’s out now on iPhone. The map starts under a thick Fog. Just like London has been the past few days. You put up Scout Towers to burn it back in bursts, and each surge reveals lost Buildings that need to be brought back. For that, you need the right resources, which must be hauled around by Trundlers along conveyor routes you lay yourself. And if a mountain gets in your way, just blow it up. ... [MORE]

title: Game of Thrones: Dragonfire now lets you build your own team of capable Commanders
summary: With the airing of House of the Dragon, Game of Thrones is roaring back to popularity in a big way. So it should be no surprise that Warner Bros. Games is giving Game of Thrones: Dragonfire, the mobile spinoff, the lion's share of attention. And now, your journey to dominate Westeros is getting assistance in the form of Commanders. If you've ever played a mobile RTS/RPG mashup, you'll know what to expect from Commanders. These individual characters can be collected and assigned to lead your force, with their distinctive abilities either buffing your own units or debuffing those of the foe, as well as synergising with the signature dragons of Dragonfire. ... [MORE]

title: Logitech's Game Day gives employees a day off to play video games
summary: If you've been keeping up with gaming news in recent weeks, you've probably noticed growing speculation about the number of gamers planning to take time off work to binge-play GTA VI when it launches on November 19th. And whilst there's no shortage of news outlets highlighting the potential economic downside of this mass gaming exodus, one particularly renowned gaming company is looking at the positives.  ... title: Hillthorn, the card-based detective sim, is out now on iOS and Android
summary: Even if Halloween is done and dusted, the November nights are drawing in, making it perfect for something spooky to play. And if that's the mood that's taking you, then publisher Raw Fury and developer Fool Moon's latest release that's just landed for iOS and Android, Hillthorn, should be more than enough in the way of chills and thrills. Hillthorn is a card-based detective sim, where you take on the role of investigating a mysterious community and the case of a disappeared child. With time in short supply, and the maze-like trails of Hillthorn Mountain threatening to swallow you whole (perhaps literally), there's not long to find out whodunnit and why. ... [MORE]

title: Chasing Kaleidorider launches sign-ups for its Doki test closed beta
summary: Of all the upcoming Tencent releases, I think one of the strangest has been Fizzglee's  Chasing Kaleidorider. Described as a doki doki romance, it'd be easy to dismiss it as just another dumb waifu game. But with sign-ups now open for their Doki test, that is to say, closed beta, you may find yourself surprised. Set in the near-future city of Terminus, you'll command the titular Kaleidoriders in their battles against invading entities from another dimension. And of course, along the way you'll slowly bond with them and perhaps even find a little romance in the process! All this featuring colourful character designs and enemies to do battle with on the open road. ... [MORE]
